title: Fix AL0254 compile error in Stock Register for Job Work report
summary: Stock Register for Job Work report in GST Subcontracting (IN) now compiles by suppressing AL0254 warnings on sort fields from a table extension that lack a covering key.
key_points: AL0254 compiler rules tightened to validate sort fields from table extensions, not just base tables
Report failed to compile with two AL0254 errors on Prod. Order No. and Prod. Order Line No. sorting
Fix uses scoped pragma to suppress AL0254 warnings without adding a key to the shared base table
Pragma pattern matches existing suppression already in the same report
No functional or schema changes; compile-only fix with no runtime behavior impact
quote: Recent AL compilers tightened AL0254 to also validate sort fields introduced by a table extension.
